cd <repo>
git commit -m "fix(lint): resolve gosec G115 (integer overflow) findings

gosec's dataflow analysis for a bounded ParseUint(...,32)->uint32
conversion doesn't cross closure boundaries, so every uid conversion
inside an h.withClient callback was flagged even though the value is
already width-checked. Convert once in the outer scope (same scope as
the ParseUint call) and pass the already-uint32 value into the
closure. Raw len()-derived and int-count conversions get an explicit
math.MaxUint32 clamp before the cast."
